title: ReportSpec ResultsBundle
description: ReportSpec v1alpha1 (DRAFT). The host-neutral results model that ReportSpec bindings resolve against. Each host converts its native results (an EvalHub job, MLflow runs, MiDojo results.json, Policy Mapper risk-extraction.json, ...) into a bundle with an adapter; a spec never sees the native format. A bundle may combine several sources, for example an ASAGO pipeline's policy risks, red-team results and EvalHub benchmark results.

subject.description: What was evaluated. When sources disagree, the first source wins and the adapter records a warning.

run.description: The run the report is about. With several sources, each source keeps its own run id in sources[].run_id.

context.description: Host context passed through to templates as run.context.* (EvalHub collection_id, ASAGO policy name, ...). Keys a host does not set print as the missing marker.

verdict.description: Overall verdict, when a source computes one (EvalHub collection pass criteria). Exposed as the built-in bindings overall_score, overall_threshold, overall_pass. Renderers never compute it.

sources.description: Provenance: one entry per native input. Copied into the evidence manifest.

adapter.description: Adapter id, e.g. evalhub-job, mlflow, midojo, asago-risk-extraction.

metric.description: Name of the metric the verdict is based on.

value.description: null when the source reports the metric as undefined (for example precision with nothing extracted).

direction.description: Filled by the adapter when the source knows it (EvalHub provider config primary_score.lower_is_better). A binding's own direction wins; a conflict is a render warning.

aliases.description: Other names the metric is known by, e.g. the MLflow-sanitized key acc_none for acc,none. References match the name first, then aliases.

label.description: Human name. Used as the series label for */metric references.

source.description: Framework or provider that produced it: lm_evaluation_harness, garak, midojo, asago-policy-mapper.

records.description: Named row sets for tables and matrices: MiDojo task pairs, Policy Mapper risks. Each row is a flat object of scalars.

attributes.description: Anything else the adapter keeps: Environment Card, EvalCard, OCI references. Reached with {evaluation, field: attributes.x.y}.
